external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that provides a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: The source does not distinguish the three partners, so they are represented as one entity.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that lists and reads files from the landing bucket and triggers a Spark transform job.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A Spark job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket where insurance partners place daily extract files.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted or whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest. Both are on defaults as far as I know.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database, which stores connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted or whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest. Both are on defaults as far as I know.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse into which the normalized claim records are loaded.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

assumptions.assumption: SFTP provides encryption in transit intrinsically.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly described as using SFTP.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it stores claim records with member names and dates of birth.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database contains confidential data because it stores partner keys and connection strings.
assumptions.basis: The source states that Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in the database.

assumptions.assumption: BigQuery contains confidential data because it stores normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the transform loads the claim records into BigQuery.
